meta.promptText: India mein men ke liye konse brand ki formal shirts kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
Agar aap office, interviews ya business meetings ke liye formal shirts lena chahte hain, to ye brands sabse achhe options hain:

### Budget (₹800–1,500)
- **Peter England** – Value for money, daily office wear ke liye bahut accha.
- **Park Avenue** – Achhi quality aur classic designs.
- **Van Heusen** – Wrinkle-resistant aur comfortable options kaafi milte hain. [www.flickonclick.com](https://www.flickonclick.com/best-formal-shirt-brands/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.indianretailer.com](https://www.indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Mid-range (₹1,500–3,000)
- **Arrow** – Premium cotton, excellent fit, meetings aur corporate wear ke liye.
- **Blackberrys** – Modern slim fit aur premium finish.
- **Allen Solly** – Formal aur smart business-casual dono ke liye accha. [www.flickonclick.com](https://www.flickonclick.com/best-formal-shirt-brands/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.indianretailer.com](https://www.indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Premium (₹2,500+)
- **Louis Philippe** – Premium fabric aur executive look.
- **Raymond** – High-quality cotton aur long-lasting shirts.
- **Zodiac** – Luxury formal shirts, fabric aur detailing ke liye mashhoor. [www.flickonclick.com](https://www.flickonclick.com/best-formal-shirt-brands/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.indianretailer.com](https://www.indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Meri recommendations
- **Best overall:** Arrow
- **Best value:** Van Heusen
- **Best premium:** Louis Philippe
- **Best budget:** Peter England

Agar aap shopping shuru karna chahte hain, to ye ek accha everyday option hai:

### [Louis Philippe Men Shirt]()
*₹1,724*

Aur kuch aur achhe options:

### [Blackberrys Men's Solid Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹2,619*

### [Peter England Men's Printed Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,179*

Agar aap apna **budget (₹1000, ₹2000, ₹3000+)** aur **body type (Slim, Regular ya Heavy)** bata denge, to main us hisaab se 5–10 specific shirts recommend kar sakta hoon.
